Hanna (Finance): Heads-up - Aurora Data INV-2026-2201 is 47 days past due. ACH bounced this morning, customer asked for two-part payment.
BillingBot: Automated alert: ACH return R01 for INV-2026-2201. Amount $23,400. Due 2026-03-29. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-2201
Diego (AE): Spoke with their CFO. They request 2 payments: 50% now, 50% in 30 days. Asking to pause external dunning while first payment is pending. Onboarding live.
Marta (Collections): We can offer two installments if: signed addendum, card on file or cleared ACH for first installment, autopay enabled. We won't waive late fees upfront. Pause external dunning only after payment auth captured.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare the short-form addendum; include suspension/reinstatement clauses. Send me the exact schedule and payment method once Diego confirms.
Hanna (Finance): Approve conditional two-part plan with conditional fee refund after first payment clears. Finance to mark invoice "on-plan" after clearance.
Diego (AE): I'll collect card auth on the 3pm call and post signed addendum here. Will ask customer to confirm autopay.
Marta (Collections): Once auth captured, I'll send outbound and flip the "pause dunning" flag. If first payment fails, immediate suspension and fees reinstated.
Diego (AE): Will update after the call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
